android.desc:
Discover SkyTrack, the weather app that values your privacy. Get accurate live weather updates and forecasts without compromising your personal data. SkyTrack is lightweight, clutter-free, and focused on what matters most—delivering weather information fast.

Features You'll Love:
🌦 Real-Time Weather Updates: Quickly check the current temperature and weather conditions for any city in the world.
📅 5-Day & 24-Hour Forecasts: Plan ahead with detailed predictions for the coming days and hours, including temperature, wind speed, humidity, and more.
🎨 Dynamic Weather Wallpapers: Immerse yourself in beautifully designed, weather-themed backgrounds that change based on the conditions in your selected city (Rain, Clouds, Snow, and more).
🔍 Effortless Search: Find your city instantly with our intuitive search bar, and view its current weather conditions at a glance.
📊 Comprehensive Weather Data: Access detailed metrics like wind direction, pressure, humidity, and visibility, all in one place.

Why Choose SkyTrack?
- Privacy-first: We don't collect or share personal data.
- Simple interface: Easily search and save cities.
- Dynamic design: Unique wallpapers for every weather type.
- Reliable updates: Live weather and 5-day forecasts.

SkyTrack Offers an Ad-Free Experience with Pro Subscription!
Why go ad-free?
- It's really cheap!
- Enhanced experience with no interruptions.
- Absolute privacy.
- Experience the ultimate Pro version, get the best out of SkyTrack!

Subscribing is easy! Tap the 'Ad-Free' button in the app to unlock uninterrupted weather insights.

Not ready to subscribe? Don’t worry! All core features remain free for everyone.

Download SkyTrack Today!
Experience the simplicity of SkyTrack. Your weather, your way—without tracking.

Internet access is required to make app's functionality work.
Ads included in this free version.

We’re constantly working to improve SkyTrack, so stay tuned for updates and new features! If you enjoy using SkyTrack, please leave us a review. 😊

Weather data provided by OpenWeather.
https://openweathermap.org/

quotes.text:
Hello HN,

I wanted to share SkyTrack, a new weather app that prioritizes simplicity, speed, and privacy. As most of the weather apps are offered by big tech's and this is an alternative made by a developer that doesn't collect your personal data.

Key Features:
No Data Collection: Unlike most weather apps, SkyTrack isn't collecting or storing any personal data. It doesn’t even request location permissions—you search for your city manually.

Clean & Minimalist UI: The app offers a lightweight, ad-free experience (with just a single unobtrusive banner ad from what is seen for support).

Challenges & Solutions:
API Management: The app intelligently queues requests, preventing overuse while maintaining fast response times.
Privacy Without Sacrifice: Avoiding the use of user tracking while still providing useful and customizable features.
SkyTrack is open to feedback, feature suggestions, or even collaboration. My hope is to prove that even simple apps can focus on user trust and still deliver value.

You can check out SkyTrack here: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.techapps.skytrack

Looking forward to your thoughts!
